## Orbiloom Valentine's 2027 — final recap

**Flight:** Wed Feb 10 – Sun Feb 14, 2027 (Auckland time; ended Mon Feb 15 00:00 NZDT / Feb 14 11:00 UTC)
**Objective:** Website clicks → landing page (https://orbiloom.app/love), optimized for link clicks
**Targeting:** iOS only; worldwide (Iran, North Korea, Cuba and Syria are not targetable on X, so they were automatically excluded); unlocalized restrictions none — all markets, all languages allowed

### Headline results

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| **Spend** | **$348.38 USD** (of $350.00 approved) |
| **Impressions** | **851,780** |
| **Link clicks** | **725** |
| Avg. CPM | $0.41 |
| Avg. cost per link click | $0.48 |
| Link CTR | 0.085% |

**Installs: not reported by X.** Because the site has no X pixel and there is no app-install campaign/app ID, X cannot see installs — so none of the figures above are installs. The 725 link clicks are clicks to the landing page, where installs happen; your App Store/attribution data is the source for the actual install count.

### Performance by post

| Ad group / post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | CPC |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Post 1 — "Small things deserve a page…" | $159.66 | 376,112 | 338 | $0.47 |
| Post 2 — "Give someone a reason to notice…" | $157.20 | 381,801 | 336 | $0.47 |
| Post 4 — "Orbiloom: free iPhone (iOS)…" | $31.52 | 93,867 | 51 | $0.62 |

*(Post 3 — "Please take a look at our app…" — was not promoted; it had no install/offer call-to-action and would have diluted budget.)*

### Management actions
- Launched 3 ad groups across approved posts 1, 2 and 4, all iOS-only, worldwide.
- **Day 1:** post 4 underperformed (CTR 0.057% vs ~0.075% for posts 1–2), so cut it to $10/day and raised posts 1–2 to $30/day.
- **Day 2:** post 4 still weakest (0.055% CTR, $0.62 CPC) — paused it and concentrated budget on posts 1–2 at $35/day, then $36/day for the final push.
- Posts 1 and 2 finished essentially tied on cost per click (~$0.47), so both were kept running through Valentine's Day.
- Ended at **$348.38 / $350** (99.5% of budget). Campaign and all ad groups are now paused/expired and no longer serving.

**Bottom line:** 851,780 impressions, 725 landing-page link clicks for $348.38. Install count must come from your App Store data — X has no visibility into it by design.
